modFunction_addAttr_value3Desc.ch: 正数增加属性，负数减少属性
modFunction_addAttr_value3Desc.en: Positive number increases stats; negative number reduces stats.

modFunction_addCurAttrPercent_value2Desc.ch: 例如当前攻击力是88，百分比填50，则增加44的攻击力。
modFunction_addCurAttrPercent_value2Desc.en: For example, if the current ATK is 88, and you enter a percentage of 50, it gains an extra 44 ATK.

modFunction_addExp_value2Name.ch: 随机最小值（数值/百分比，可以填入负数）
modFunction_addExp_value2Name.en: Random Min Value (Value/Percentage, can be negative)

modFunction_addExp_value3Name.ch: 随机最大值（数值/百分比，可以填入负数）

modFunction_addFeature_value2Desc.ch: 例如填6，则6个月后气运消失。
modFunction_addFeature_value2Desc.en: For example: If you enter 6 months, Destiny will disappear after 6 months.

modFunction_addPotmon_value4Name.ch: 是否在战斗中立刻生效

modFunction_callDrama_value1Desc.ch: 可以填入多个剧情ID，所有达成条件的剧情，根据权重随机打开一个。
modFunction_callDrama_value1Desc.en: You may add multiple plot IDs. Among all the plots whose conditions are met, a random one will be launched according to the weight.

modFunction_clearFeature_value1Name.ch: 清除的气运ID（-1清除所有负面气运）
modFunction_clearFeature_value1Name.en: Destiny ID to delete (-1 deletes all negative destinies)

modFunction_clearInEventID_value1Name.en: ID of the event under Player's feet

modFunction_clearWorldData_value1Desc.ch:
一般用于标记，如有个奇遇是《遇到老奶奶》，奇遇有个按钮是《扶老奶奶过马路》，按钮上有个命令增加标记“玩家曾经扶了老奶奶过马路”。

另一个奇遇是《剑仙老奶奶》，奇遇触发条件里可以判断标记“玩家曾经扶了老奶奶过马路”存在才能触发这个奇遇。
modFunction_clearWorldData_value1Desc.en:
Often used to mark data. For example, in [Adventure A], there's a [Button X], which carries a command that marks Player with [Key Y].

Then, you can add [Key Y] to the second [Adventure B]'s triggering condition, making it only available when Player has completed [Adventure A].

modFunction_createDungeonInRange_value1D.ch: 副本距离玩家最小多少格
modFunction_createDungeonInRange_value1D.en: The minimum amount of tiles the dungeon can be away from the player

modFunction_createDungeonInRange_value2D.ch: 副本距离玩家最大多少格

modFunction_createDungeon_value4Name.ch: 副本等级偏移随机最大值
modFunction_createDungeon_value4Name.en: Dungeon Level Offset Random Max Value

modFunction_createDungeon_value5Desc.ch: 持续时间到达后，副本将删除，通关副本胜利后，副本也会被删除。
modFunction_createDungeon_value5Desc.en: When the timer runs out or when the dungeon is cleared, the dungeon will be deleted.

modFunction_createEventArea_value3Name.ch: 事件距离建筑最小距离

modFunction_createEventArea_value4Name.ch: 事件距离建筑最大距离

modFunction_getWell_value1Name.ch: 恢复状态前，打开的剧情

modFunction_intoDungeon_value3Desc.ch:
副本等级限制在1-50级，一个境界对应5级，如筑基期，10级副本代表筑基期最难副本，6级副本代表筑基期最简单副本。

副本等级类型说明
0-固定等级：副本等级偏移可以输入1-50，固定副本等级。

1：例如当玩家是筑基境时，副本基础等级是10级，偏移填-4，那么副本等级就是6级。

2：例如当玩家在白源区（练气境）时，副本基础等级是5，偏移填-3，那么副本等级是2级。
modFunction_intoDungeon_value3Desc.en:
Dungeon level is limited to between 1 to 50. Each realm is corresponded to 5 levels. For example, in the foundation realm, Lv.10 is the most difficult, and Lv.6 is the easiest.

Dungeon level type info
0- Fixed level: enter an offset value between 1 to 50 to set the dungeon level to a fixed value.

1: E.g., when Player is in Foundation realm, the base dungeon level is 10. If you enter an offset value of -4, then the dungeon level will be 6.

2: E.g., when Player is in Bai Yuan (Qi Refining), the base dungeon level is 5. If you enter an offset value of -3, then the dungeon level will be 2.

modFunction_setDramaUnitData_value1Desc.ch:
例如：设置左边抓取的角色是玩家，右边抓取的角色是张三，则可以弹出剧情与张三互动。

也可以只设置右边抓取的NPC，则左边默认是玩家。
modFunction_setDramaUnitData_value1Desc.en:
For example: If the character to extract on the left is set as the player, and the character to extract on the right is a certain character, then a plot will pop up to interact with that character.

If you only set the character to extract on the right, the character on the left will be the player by default.
